name: gpaster
description: A focused desktop clipboard history for macOS and Windows.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: tsc --module Node16 --moduleResolution Node16 --target ES2022 --rootDir . --outDir work/test-build --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node electron/history-store.test.ts electron/local-stores.test.ts electron/trusted-origin.test.ts electron/clipboard-images.test.ts electron/screenshot-monitor.test.ts electron/i18n.test.ts electron/preferences.test.ts electron/file-store.test.ts && node --test work/test-build/electron/history-store.test.js work/test-build/electron/local-stores.test.js work/test-build/electron/trusted-origin.test.js work/test-build/electron/clipboard-images.test.js work/test-build/electron/screenshot-monitor.test.js work/test-build/electron/i18n.test.js work/test-build/electron/preferences.test.js work/test-build/electron/file-store.test.js
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npx --yes @electron/packager . G-paster --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=work/packaged --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.gpaster.desktop --icon=assets/G-paster.icns --extend-info=scripts/macos-agent-info.plist --ignore='^/(work|outputs|src|electron|scripts|docs)(/|$)|^/node_modules/(\.vite|\.package-lock\.json)(/|$)|^/(README\.md|CHANGELOG\.md|index\.html|vite\.config\.mts|tsconfig\.[^/]+\.json|\.gitignore)$|^/assets/(G-paster\.icns|G-paster-brand\.png|tray-icon\.svg|GpasterTemplate(@2x)?\.png|localizations)(/|$)' && node scripts/package-macos-localizations.mjs
